unite_adi: REGULAR UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 11-LEVEL: B1.3 THEME 8: LIFE IN THE UNIVERSE & FUTURE

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will explore the theme ''Life in the Universe and the Future'' project competition by researching and discussing future lifestyles and future technologies and inventions. They will examine how advancements in artificial intelligence and robotics could impact daily life, from the use of robots in homes and workplaces to the development of smart cities and transportation systems. Students will also explore the potential of new technologies, such as renewable energy sources, space exploration, and medical innovations, and consider how these advancements might shape human society in the coming year. The assignment will require students to present their findings in a creative format, such as a report or presentation, imagining what life might look like in the future and how technology will redefine human interaction, work, and leisure. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/ or a marking scheme. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''life in the universe and the future with its components such as future lifestyles, future technologies and inventions'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in an upper secondary school may know what life in the universe and the future with its components such as future lifestyles, future technologies and inventions mean in their own language as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students of an upper secondary school in year 11, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''life in the universe and the future'' in English from previous themes and/or years such as ''aliens, mysterious, creatures, intelligence, to exist and so on'' and also some structures such as ''If you have an opportunity, where will you visit in the universe? If you go to the Moon, everything floats in space'' in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in an upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''life in the universe and the future with its components such as future lifestyles, future technologies and inventions'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss the poster and/or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as a preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To describe futuristic scenarios and innovations in English by using target vocabulary and target grammar. Activity: Imagining the Future The teacher begins the activity asking students to imagine a futuristic lifestyle, such as living in smart homes equipped with AI or using flying cars. The teacher provides examples using the target grammar and vocabulary (e.g., ''If I could design a smart kitchen, it would be equipped with augmented reality'', or ''I wish my home had AI assistants to make life easier''). Students then write a short story about their imagined future, using Conditional 2 and wish clauses along with vocabulary such as wearable technology, robots, holograms, and solar panels. After writing, students read their stories aloud. The teacher listens and gives feedback on pronunciation and sentence accuracy. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To talk about future lifestyles and technologies in English by using target vocabulary and target grammar. Activity: Future Dreams with Technologies The teacher starts the activity by showing flashcards with words such as smart homes, robots, holograms, solar panels, and AI home assistants. The teacher explains each word with simple visuals or examples. Students work in pairs and complete a worksheet with Conditional 2 sentences such as ''If I could design a smart home, ''. or ''If I had a flying car, ''. They use the words from the flashcards to fill in the blanks (e.g., ''If I had a flying car, I would travel anywhere in minutes''.). In the end, the teacher checks their answers and provides feedback on pronunciation and accuracy. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
